text: A psalm of David. I The Lord is my shepherd; [1]there is nothing I lack. [AA]
In green pastures he makes me lie down;to still waters he leads me;
t[AB] he restores my soul.He guides me along right paths [2]for the sake of his name.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, [AC]I will fear no evil, for you are with me;your rod and your staff comfort me.
II [3]You set a table before mein front of my enemies; [4]You anoint my head with oil; [5] [AD]my cup overflows. [AE]
Indeed, goodness and mercy [6] will pursue meall the days of my life;I will dwell in the house of the Lord [AF]for endless days.
